business_problem: Suzhou Universal needed a faster way to analyze production quality and adjust schedules because MES, ERP, APS, and quality systems were disconnected, cross-system queries were slow, and manual coordination created errors and delayed operational decisions.
solution_summary: Suzhou Universal and X-POWER built an Agentic AI Platform on IBM watsonx Orchestrate to unify production data, quality analysis, and scheduling workflows across the factory environment. The platform connects MES, ERP, APS, and quality systems into a shared data foundation that users can query through natural language instead of hopping between applications. One set of agents focuses on quality inquiry and automated analysis, aggregating production and defect data so teams can monitor issues in real time, spot trends, and investigate likely root causes. Another agent handles production scheduling, allowing planners to request changes in natural language while validating those changes inside a draft environment with side-by-side comparisons and risk checks before execution. By orchestrating data and decisions rather than automating isolated tasks, the platform gives Suzhou Universal a safer, faster operating model for production management and creates a scalable base for further intelligent-manufacturing initiatives.

solution_components.name: Agentic AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the unified application layer that connects quality inquiry, scheduling, and cross-system analysis workflows.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Orchestrate
solution_components.role: Coordinates agents, data, and workflows across MES, ERP, APS, and quality systems.

data_flow: Operational data from MES, ERP, APS, and quality systems is unified into a shared foundation, watsonx Orchestrate routes user requests through quality or scheduling agents, and the system returns real-time analysis or draft-validated schedule changes before they are applied to production.
business_outcome: Suzhou Universal cut cross-system query and analysis times sharply, reduced scheduling errors, improved root-cause accuracy, and created a scalable foundation for intelligent manufacturing.
